AltergressiveV2 README
Run with these tweaks

##Main Settings##
!preset custom
!teamsize 8
!bset assistdronesbuildpowermultiplier 1
!bset assistdronesenabled enabled
!bset commanderbuildersbuildpower 1000
!bset commanderbuildersenabled enabled
!bset commanderbuildersrange 2000
!bset disablemapdamage 1
!bset experimentalextraunits 1
!bset experimentallegionfaction 1
!bset experimentalshields absorbeverything
!bset maxunits 1000
!bset scavunitsforplayers 1
!bset forceallunits 1
!bset evocom 1
!bset evocomlevelupmultiplier 0.5
$rename PvE [Modded BarBs] Extra+Scav+Legion Settings
$welcome-message Altergressive AI is based on (now deprecated) Felnious AI found here: (https://github.com/Kazuhira95/BARbots) Forked from: (https://github.com/Felnious/Skirmish)


##Tweakdefs##
T3 Geo  Wall  Nanos  Spy Satellite  = tweakdefs1
             T4 Defense             = tweakdefs2
       Arm Leg LVL 10 Shield        = tweakdefs3
            Epic Shields            = tweakdefs4
       Epic Bulwark For Com         = tweakdefs5
               T4 ECO               = tweakdefs6
            DefensiveSuper          = tweakdefs7
           RepairCarriers           = tweakdefs8
           
!bset tweakdefs1 
!bset tweakdefs2 
!bset tweakdefs3 
!bset tweakdefs4 

!bset tweakdefs5 
!bset tweakdefs6 
!bset tweakdefs7 
!bset tweakdefs8 -
